body:
This does not produce valid GDScript, as your examples show. The indentation parameters are for adding new lines, not for formatting existing lines, there isn't enough information to handle all cases that will be wanted for good formatting. Actual code formatting is much more complex and needs more language info. 
So this is only maybe useful in some simple languages, users will still have to add their own formatting system in almost all cases.

What is the use case of this? The proposal says it is to "improve the CodeEdit node", but [there needs to be an actual issue first](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/guidelines/best_practices.html#the-problem-always-comes-first).

> The indentation parameters are for adding new lines, not for formatting existing lines, there isn't enough information to handle all cases that will be wanted for good formatting. Actual code formatting is much more complex and needs more language info. So this is only maybe useful in some simple languages, users will still have to add their own formatting system in almost all cases.

For that, we can make this function overidable like `_filter_code_completion_candidates` so peopole can make their own parameters if needed. 

>  This does not produce valid GDScript, as your examples show. 

I don't see why... is it beacause we can have a jump between two lines and still need a tabulation ? My idea was to add a simple function to add a simple tool that make things faster but I can update the function to be more precise if you want.

> What is the use case of this? The proposal says it is to "improve the CodeEdit node", but [there needs to be an actual issue first](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/guidelines/best_practices.html#the-problem-always-comes-first).

My first idea was to add a bunch of tools for the `CodeEdit` node but it was pointed out to me that some of my ideas were either too useless for the node or not well thought out, this function being the only thing I finished before I was told that, I pushed it in case you are interested and to have feedback on how to improve it. The goal is to have a tool similar to VSCode that allows you to quickly format a script, having this as a function integrated directly into Godot seemed like a good idea to me.
